task.goal: Open the file task.html in Downloads in the file manager; when prompted open it with Chrome. Then create a drawing using the three colors shown at the top and hit submit.
task.final_summary: I opened task.html from Downloads in the file manager and chose Chrome when prompted. The page was a color challenge: the three colors at the top were orange, navy blue and purple. I selected those three swatches from the palette and drew a stroke with each on the canvas, then tapped Submit. The page confirmed the submission with "Success!".

steps.note: Observe current screen to find the file manager and Downloads
Launch file manager (documentsui) and browse Downloads
Tap task.html in Downloads to open it
Tap Chrome in the Open with dialog
Select Chrome row in Open with dialog, then check if Open button enables
Open task.html in Chrome with Just once
Dismiss Chrome first-run screen to reach task.html
Decline sync with No thanks
Tap No thanks again to finish Chrome first-run
Reopen task.html; Chrome first-run is finished so Just once should load the page
Tap Just once to open task.html with Chrome
Tap Just once button coordinates to launch Chrome with the file
Read the loaded task.html page contents in Chrome
Read task.html source to understand the drawing requirements
Screenshot to see the three target colors and palette colors
Identify which palette swatches match the three target colors
Tap the orange palette swatch then draw on canvas to see behavior
Draw an orange stroke on the canvas and screenshot to verify
Check whether the swipe drew on the canvas
Clear canvas, then draw one navy stroke
Select navy swatch then draw a navy stroke
Draw navy stroke on canvas
Select orange swatch and draw orange stroke
Draw orange stroke on canvas
Select purple swatch and draw purple stroke
Draw purple stroke, then screenshot to verify all three colors present
Verify the canvas shows three strokes in navy, orange, purple
Tap Submit on the Color Challenge page
Task complete
